theater: 亞美尼亞高原與幼發拉底河上游

battle.name: 58-63年羅馬-安息戰爭
battle.theater: 亞美尼亞高原與幼發拉底河上游
battle.brief: 公元58至63年，羅馬與安息為亞美尼亞王位與幼發拉底河中游緩衝王國開戰。皇帝尼祿派科爾布諾出使仲裁，仲裁卻變成對抗：安息王子沃洛加塞二世在63年的蘭迪亞被羅馬打敗，提格拉諾克塔被圍。卡面的亞述長矛是前900年的短柄長刃鐵矛，本役對應的實物是安息重騎兵的康托斯長矛與羅馬的短柄刺槍。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 公元58至63年的羅馬－安息戰爭，掛在戰場上的是羅馬帝國與安息帝國，真正被爭奪的卻是亞美尼亞的王位與幼發拉底河中游的一串緩衝王國。羅馬在東方把亞美尼亞、奧斯羅埃尼、索菲恩、科馬基尼與卡帕多細亞連成一條屏障，任何一國倒向安息，安息騎兵就可能在一夜之間越過幼發拉底河。羅馬方面的指揮系統屬於皇帝尼祿直轄的卡帕多細亞：以總督兼東方全權使者加尼烏斯·多米提烏斯·科爾布諾為首，主力為第三高盧軍團、第六鐵軍團與第十五阿波利納里斯軍團，再加卡帕多細亞、敘利亞兩地的輔助步兵、弓箭手與騎兵，另有新任敘利亞總督馬庫斯·烏爾皮烏斯·圖拉真手下可用的一支兵。亞美尼亞則是羅馬的附庸國，其軍隊與宮廷分屬互相猜忌的派系，這正是羅馬能插手的前提。安息方面的結構是國王沃洛加塞一世加上樞密重臣蘇雷納斯，王子沃洛加塞二世既掛亞美尼亞王號，又是前線的實際統帥；安息軍隊的主幹是重騎兵與弓兵，這支部隊不為任何行省服務，只為國王的目標服務。
countriesEn: The Roman–Parthian war of AD 58–63 was fought in name between the Roman Empire and the Parthian Empire, but what was really at stake was the throne of Armenia and the string of buffer kingdoms along the middle Euphrates. Rome had strung Armenia, Osrhoene, Sophene, Commagene and Cappadocia together into a single screen across the east, and if any one of them turned, Parthian horsemen might be across the Euphrates within a night. Rome's command structure on that side was the province of Cappadocia, under the emperor Nero's own authority: at the head stood Gnaeus Domitius Corbulo, governor of Cappadocia and legate with supreme authority in the east, with the Third Gallica, Sixth Ferrata and Fifteenth Apollinaris legions as the core, supplemented by auxiliaries, archers and cavalry from Cappadocia and Syria, and with a further body of men available under the new governor of Syria, Marcus Ulpius Traianus. Armenia was a Roman client kingdom, and its troops and its court were split among factions that distrusted one another, which was precisely the opening that let Rome intervene. The Parthian structure was King Vologases I together with the grandee Surenas of the royal council, while the prince Vologases II bore the title of king of Armenia and was the real commander in the field; the backbone of the Parthian army was heavy cavalry and archery, and that force served no province, only the king's objective.
people: 這場戰爭留下名字的人不少，但真正推著它走的是六位。皇帝尼祿在位於公元54至68年，起初並不想打仗：他只想用一個傀儡王的加冕問題拖住安息，把仲裁交給自己信任的將領，自己留在羅馬過日常。加尼烏斯·多米提烏斯·科爾布諾是關鍵人物，他以使節身分赴亞美尼亞仲裁，卻在蘭迪亞拒絕把王冠交給安息王子，親手為提格蘭五世加冕；此舉同時得罪安息王與亞美尼亞王，卻也讓他成為羅馬在東方唯一的支點，59年他被召回，62年重新出發，63年在蘭迪亞之役打垮安息軍。卡帕多細亞的財政官提格利努斯因拒絕把軍餉交給提格蘭五世而捲入糾紛，後來升任禁衛軍總監，63年奉命率援軍到東方主持和談。敘利亞總督圖拉真在61至62年間解了埃德薩之圍，數週之內收復亞美尼亞、索菲恩與奧斯羅埃尼，替科爾布諾清空了戰場。安息一方的樞密重臣蘇雷納斯圍困埃德薩、策動索菲恩的內應，是安息這邊唯一握有戰略主動權的人。提格蘭五世於59年被自己的貴族殺死；他的幼子提里達特斯被科爾布諾於60年俘獲送往羅馬，日後卻在66年成為亞美尼亞唯一的王。
peopleEn: Several people left their names on this war, and six of them moved it. The emperor Nero, reigning from AD 54 to 68, did not want the war at all: his plan was to let the question of crowning a puppet king drag the Parthians along, hand the arbitration to an officer he trusted, and stay in Rome to his usual routine. Gnaeus Domitius Corbulo is the pivotal figure. He went to Armenia as envoy to arbitrate, then at Rhandeia refused to hand the diadem to the Parthian prince and crowned Tigranes V himself. That single act offended the Parthian king and the Armenian king at once, and at the same time made Corbulo the one fixed point of Roman power in the East: recalled in 59, sent out again in 62, and in 63 the man who broke the Parthian army at the battle of Rhandeia. Gaius Ofonius Tigellinus, the procurator of Cappadocia, was drawn into the quarrel for refusing to hand over the money owed to Tigranes V; he later rose to be prefect of the Praetorian Guard, and in 63 Nero sent him east with reinforcements to conduct the peace talks. Trajan, governor of Syria, raised the siege of Edessa in AD 61–62 and recovered Armenia, Sophene and Osrhoene within weeks, clearing the ground for Corbulo. On the Parthian side Surenas, councillor of the royal house, besieged Edessa and engineered the defection in Sophene, and was the only man there with real strategic initiative. Tigranes V was murdered by his own nobles in 59; his young son Tiridates was taken prisoner by Corbulo in 60 and sent to Rome, yet in 66 he became the sole king of Armenia.
kits: 卡面是亞述長矛：短柄、長刃、配鐵鏢的步兵矛，前900年上下已在兩河流域成軍，亞述人把它同弓與鐵器綁在一起，靠密集的矛列攻城拔寨。它在本役的位置是血統上的對照件：安息重步兵與重騎兵所用的長柄康托斯，以及阿黑美尼德、塞琉古的長矛方陣，都可以沿這條線往回追；而羅馬人手中形制最接近亞述矛的，是短柄長鐵刃的刺槍哈斯塔（hasta），柄短、刃長，專門用來刺穿盾牌而非投擲。真正在場的裝備是這樣的：安息一方的核心是鐵鏢長柄的康托斯、複合弓，以及重騎兵防護用的鐵片鎧、鎖子甲與馬頷護甲；輕裝弓手以箭雨製造壓力，進攻時用大柳條盾與填土築成的斜坡抵擋箭雨，缺口再以攻城撞車與長梯打開。羅馬一方有兩米上下的標槍、半圓大盾、短劍與分段式甲，還有弩炮與擺臂式投石機等攻城器材。貫穿全場的不是任何一件單兵兵器，而是馬：安息的戰術全部建立在馬背的機動與弓手的射界上，羅馬則靠驛站、糧車與冬營維持從幼發拉底河到亞美尼亞的縱深。
kitsEn: The card shows the Assyrian spear: a short-hafted, long-bladed infantry spear with an iron head, already organised in the armies of Mesopotamia around 900 BC, when the Assyrians used it together with the bow and with iron, taking walled city after walled city with a close-packed line of spears. Its place in this war is that of a lineal reference piece. The long-shafted kontos carried by the Parthian heavy infantry and heavy cavalry, and the long-spear phalanxes of the Achaemenids and the Seleucids, can all be traced back along that line; and the weapon in Roman hands whose form comes closest to the Assyrian spear is the short-hafted thrusting spear, the hasta, with a long iron head made to drive through a shield rather than to be thrown. What was actually in the field runs as follows. On the Parthian side the core was the iron-headed long kontos, the composite bow, and for the heavy cavalry scale and mail armour with a chamfron for the horse; light archers supplied the crushing weight of arrows, and on the attack they used large wicker shields and earthen ramps to defeat the arrow shower, opening the line with rams and scaling ladders. The Romans had javelins of about two metres, the semicircular scutum, the gladius and segmentata armour, and such siege machines as the ballista and the onager. What really ran through the whole war was not any single hand weapon but the horse: every Parthian tactic rested on mounted mobility and on the shooting range of the bow, while Rome kept the depth between the Euphrates and Armenia alive with stations, grain wagons and winter camps.
tactics: 安息軍的戰法有兩套，兩套都見過血。安息弓陣先以複合弓覆蓋前線，箭雨壓住羅馬的盾線；重騎兵不直衝，先以散騎在兩翼遊走、射擊、放棄位置，把羅馬縱隊引離正路，待敵隊形拉開、重裝騎兵才以長柄康托斯低平衝鋒，馬速加矛衝力一起作用，這就是後世所稱的安息射擊加重騎兵衝鋒的標準組合。守城與野戰時，安息人用大柳條盾與填土的斜坡組成龜甲式的防箭陣，長矛手在後排，弓箭手在後；等防箭結構吸收了羅馬的箭雨，再用撞車與長梯把城牆打開。羅馬方面不跟安息人比機動，而比重步兵的韌性與工兵：以密集縱隊與盾牆行軍，宿營挖壕、以柵牆圍住營區，渡河與行軍都選在能讓敵騎兵失去衝擊距離的狹窄地形，把安息騎兵引到河岸、平原與山口的短距離裡再打。科爾布諾本人更重要的手段是外交與圍城：他先不求決戰，用封鎖、離間與拖延把安息的聯盟拆開，最後才在63年於蘭迪亞集中兵力，據地形的斜坡陣迎擊，讓安息軍主動來攻，再以預備的騎兵在對方陣腳鬆動時反擊取勝。
tacticsEn: The Parthian army had two sets of method, and both of them had been blooded. The Parthian archers covered the front first, an arrow rain that pinned the Roman shield line; the heavy cavalry did not charge straight away but scattered on the wings to shoot, give ground and draw the Roman column off the direct line, and only when the Roman formation had been stretched and opened did the armoured lancers come in low with the long kontos, horse speed and the weight of the lance working together — the standard combination of the Parthian shot followed by the cataphract charge. In the field and in defence, the Parthians built a testudo against arrows out of large wicker shields and earth-filled ramps, with the pikemen in the rear rank and the archers behind them; once that arrow-proof structure had absorbed the Roman volleys, they opened the wall with rams and ladders. The Romans did not try to match the Parthians in mobility; they competed in the endurance of heavy infantry and in engineering. They marched in close column and behind the shield wall, dug a ditch and fenced the camp on every night's halt, chose crossings and lines of march so that the ground denied the Parthian horsemen their charge, and drew the enemy down to river banks, plains and defiles where the distance was short. Corbulo's own strongest methods, however, were diplomatic and siege: he avoided seeking a decision, used blockade, division and delay to break up the Parthian alliance, and only in 63 concentrated his force at Rhandeia, took a position on the slope of the ground and made the Parthians attack, then struck with the cavalry reserve when their formation loosened.
data: 這場戰爭的數字殘缺，必須分清哪些有文本、哪些只是推算。有文本的部分：戰爭起於公元58年，止於63年，前後六年，涵蓋兩個作戰季節加一場冬季外交；羅馬在東方投入的常備軍團是第三高盧、第六鐵、第十五阿波利納里斯三個；科爾布諾的野戰軍通常被後世放在一萬八千至兩萬人之間，這是估算而非原文所載；圖拉真在61至62年靠一批新到的行省兵解埃德薩之圍並收復三地，說明羅馬在東方可用的機動兵力並不少。沒有文本的部分：安息方面的兵員、各次戰役的傷亡與俘虜數幾乎全部失傳，只能從安息人騎兵加弓箭的結構推測其傾斜，不能寫成具體人數。地理尺度可以核：由提格拉諾克塔到泰西封直線約六百三十公里，沿河谷行軍接近一千公里；亞美尼亞的國土約三十萬平方公里，而羅馬要把軍糧從敘利亞、卡帕多細亞運到亞美尼亞山道，全線超過一千五百公里。另一組可對照的數字是城：提格拉諾克塔與埃德薩都是當時兩河流域外圍最大的設防城之一，同時代記載中的攻城塔高度常被推到二十米上下，攻城梯則按城牆高度而定。
dataEn: The figures for this war are fragmentary, and it matters which of them rest on text and which are inference. What rests on text: the war began in AD 58 and ended in 63, six years in all, covering two campaigning seasons and one winter of diplomacy; the standing Roman legions in the east were the Third Gallica, Sixth Ferrata and Fifteenth Apollinaris; the field army of Corbulo is usually put by later writers at between eighteen and twenty thousand men, and that is an estimate rather than a figure from the text; Trajan was able in AD 61–62 to raise the siege of Edessa with newly raised provincial troops and recover the three lands within weeks, which shows that Rome had no small mobile force in the east. What does not rest on text: Parthian strengths, and the casualties and prisoners of the individual actions, are almost entirely lost, and the lean of the Parthian army can only be inferred from its structure of horsemen and archers, not written down as a number. The scale of geography can be checked: the straight line from Tigranocerta to Ctesiphon is about six hundred and thirty kilometres, and close to a thousand by the river valleys; Armenia is about three hundred thousand square kilometres, while grain had to travel from Syria and Cappadocia along the Armenian mountain roads, a line of more than fifteen hundred kilometres. One more comparable set of numbers concerns cities: Tigranocerta and Edessa were among the largest fortified cities on the outer edge of the Mesopotamian world, and the siege towers in the accounts of that siege are commonly given a height of some twenty metres, with the scaling ladders set to the height of the walls.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最外層是地緣：安息帝國在美索不達米亞平原與伊朗高原上，羅馬在安納托利亞高原與地中海，兩者之間只隔著亞美尼亞、奧斯羅埃尼與科馬基尼這幾個小國。誰控制亞美尼亞，誰就控制從幼發拉底河翻越山口的通道，以及通往卡帕多細亞的多條古道。第二層是王位繼承：亞美尼亞的老王阿爾塔克西亞斯四世在54年之後不久去世，羅馬把王位給了提格蘭五世，安息國王沃洛加塞一世則堅持要讓自己的兒子沃洛加塞二世繼承；對安息來說，讓安息王子坐上亞美尼亞王座，就等於把羅馬的屏障變成自己的前線。第三層是仲裁本身：科爾布諾在蘭迪亞的裁決被安息視為欺騙，被亞美尼亞王視為背叛，兩個客人同時反目。第四層是尼祿的算盤：皇帝不想為一個山國開一場大戰，於是拒絕承認安息王子，也拒絕讓提格蘭五世獨占亞美尼亞；可是安息王同樣不接受退讓，於是本該是外交的仲裁滑成了全面對抗。
causeEn: There were four layers of cause. The outermost was geography: the Parthian Empire stood on the Mesopotamian plain and the Iranian plateau, Rome on the Anatolian plateau and the Mediterranean, and between them lay only a few small states — Armenia, Osrhoene and Commagene. Whoever held Armenia held the passes that crossed the Euphrates and the old roads that ran toward Cappadocia. The second layer was the succession: when the old king of Armenia, Artaxias IV, died shortly after AD 54, Rome gave the throne to Tigranes V, while the Parthian king Vologases I insisted that his own son Vologases II should succeed — for Parthia, a Parthian prince on the Armenian throne meant turning Rome's screen into its own forward position. The third layer was the arbitration itself: Corbulo's verdict at Rhandeia was read by the Parthians as deception and by the Armenian king as betrayal, and two guests turned on their host at once. The fourth layer was Nero's arithmetic: the emperor did not want a great war over a hill country, so he refused to recognise the Parthian prince, and equally refused to let Tigranes V keep Armenia alone; but the Parthian king would not give way either, and so an arbitration that should have stayed diplomatic slid into open confrontation.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果，一半在亞美尼亞，一半在羅馬的邊疆制度。亞美尼亞方面：羅馬終於把亞美尼亞王位變成由皇帝直接頒授、可以隨時撤換的頭銜；66年維斯帕薌改立提里達特斯一世為亞美尼亞唯一的王，其治下疆域大體即今日土耳其東部與伊朗西北的亞美尼亞高原，從此成為羅馬的內附王國，直到羅馬的邊界在公元三、四世紀退到幼發拉底河。制度方面：這場戰爭把用附庸王做仲裁者的做法固定下來，羅馬的附庸王國科馬基尼、奧斯羅埃尼、索菲恩與卡帕多細亞的守軍編制、行省總督與東方全權使者如科爾布諾、圖拉真都因此定型；安息也學會了同一套，用親王的加冕與邊境附庸的安置來對抗羅馬的介入。長期看，這場戰爭沒有解決問題，只是把問題凍結：羅馬不敢把安息王子從王座上拉下來，安息也拿不到亞美尼亞；這種僵持一直延續到公元113年圖拉真大舉進攻美索不達米亞，兩國才用一場全面戰爭來解決五十年的邊界爭執。
impactEn: The consequences of this war were half in Armenia and half in the institutions of the Roman frontier. In Armenia: Rome finally turned the Armenian throne into a title conferred by the emperor and revocable at will; in AD 66 Vespasian installed Tiridates I as the single king of Armenia, and the kingdom he ruled was substantially the Armenian plateau of what is now eastern Turkey and north-western Iran, which from then on was an interior dependency of Rome until the Roman frontier fell back to the Euphrates in the third and fourth centuries. Institutionally, the war fixed the practice of using client kings as arbitrators: the garrison systems, the provincial commands and the eastern legates with supreme authority — Corbulo, Trajan — were all shaped by it, and Parthia learned the same lesson, answering Roman intervention with the crowning of its own princes and the placement of its own border clients. In the long run the war solved nothing; it froze the problem instead. Rome could not pull the Parthian prince off the throne and Parthia could not take Armenia, and the stalemate held until AD 113, when Trajan's great invasion of Mesopotamia settled fifty years of frontier dispute in a general war.
result: 打完之後，安息王沃洛加塞一世退回美索不達米亞，羅馬贏了亞美尼亞的處置權，卻沒有贏走亞美尼亞本身。63至64年間的協議大致是這樣：亞美尼亞王座留給安息王子沃洛加塞二世，首都仍在提格拉諾克塔；索菲恩被併入卡帕多細亞行省，奧斯羅埃尼置於羅馬官員與駐軍的監督之下；安息放棄對這兩處的爭議，作為交換，羅馬承認安息在阿迪亞貝尼與底格里斯河下游的既有地位。純粹從軍事的角度看，羅馬這場是清楚的優勢：安息軍在蘭迪亞被擊潰，提格拉諾克塔被圍，援軍未能解圍，士氣與補給都垮了下來。但按羅馬自己的目標看，這只是一場成功的止戰：皇帝既不願意也沒有能力把戰爭推到底格里斯河去。提格拉諾克塔之圍未解，提格利努斯已奉命到東方主持和談；科爾布諾被命向泰西封推進，並沒有真正的遠征計畫，67年他再度奉命出發、準備把和約向安息施加壓力時，卻在敘利亞病亡，計畫隨之取消。66年羅馬換掉沃洛加塞二世、另立提里達特斯一世，把停戰線固定下來，亞美尼亞問題於是擱置，雙方再未大規模交手，直到公元113年。
resultEn: When it was over, the Parthian king Vologases I had withdrawn to Mesopotamia: Rome had won the disposal of Armenia, but not Armenia itself. The settlement of AD 63–64 was roughly this. The Armenian throne was left to the Parthian prince Vologases II, with the capital still at Tigranocerta; Sophene was absorbed into the Roman province of Cappadocia and Osrhoene was placed under the supervision of Roman officers and garrisons; the Parthians gave up their claims to those two lands, and in exchange Rome acknowledged the existing Parthian position in Adiabene and in the lower Tigris. On the purely military view Rome's performance was clear: the Parthian army was broken at Rhandeia, Tigranocerta was besieged, the relieving force failed to arrive, and both morale and supply collapsed. But by Rome's own stated aim this was only a successful stopping of the war: the emperor had neither the wish nor the power to carry it through to the Tigris. Before the siege of Tigranocerta was resolved, Tigellinus had already been sent east to conduct the peace; the order that Corbulo should advance on Ctesiphon had no real expedition behind it, and in 67, when he was sent out again to press the terms on Parthia, he fell ill and died in Syria, and the plan died with him. In 66 Rome replaced Vologases II with Tiridates I and fixed the line of suspension, the Armenian question was set aside, and the two powers did not clash on a large scale again until AD 113.
